features.feature: Analyzer reads the four committed evidence streams (batch-ledger.jsonl, tamper-verdicts.jsonl, resume-reconciliation.json) plus protocol.json
Adjudicate each hypothesis H1/H2/H3/H4 to a three-state verdict (pass|fail|inconclusive)
Emit report.json + human-readable report.md
Report carries a reproducible digest = sha256(canonicalJson(report minus digest)); re-run on same inputs yields byte-identical report+digest
Analyzer never re-executes the instrument and never calls the lattice CLI (purely offline)
Hermetic selfcheck-m4.mjs asserts the three-state derivation is correct and un-gameable (tampered/missing/insufficient evidence -> inconclusive or fail, never a false pass)
Genuine Codex cross-host pass independently replicates the report digest
H1 replay-determinism: pairwise digest/gold-metric equality across replay proof records per scale; a stop record makes H1 not-evaluable at that scale
H2 tamper-fail-closed: adjudicated via per-class fingerprint match against protocol.json (fail-closed set vs accepted-behavior bucket)
H3 campaign integrity (proof-or-stop): identity-multiset reconciliation against protocol cross-product, 0 dup/0 gap
H4 scale envelope: cap-vs-stop accounting (budget_cap breach must be stop-recorded, never a silent overrun)
Per-record recordDigest re-verification runs FIRST before adjudication; any mismatch aborts the verdict with the named record id (naively-edited-ledger detection)
Report includes scale-envelope numbers per section 7 artifact table (elapsed / endOfRunRss per scale/iteration)
No-overclaim rule: section-3 claim text embedded verbatim in report.md ONLY when all four hypotheses are supported
When any hypothesis is falsified/not-evaluable, report states it plainly with the machine-readable reason (no claim text embedded)
Final summary lists any instrument defect found by the campaign (per DoD section 12)
Codex cross-host replication at M4: independently re-runs analyze-batch.mjs against the committed ledger and reproduces the report digest (section 6.5 item 3)
M0 protocol freeze, tamper-class viability check, and cost calibration (protocol.json)
